title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.reason: Sharp ventricular upstroke and post-downstroke return to local baseline are identifiable. Small Q/S components may be obscured by trace thickness. Approximate reader-union envelope, conditional on course speed. This envelope includes reader and endpoint uncertainty; it is not a confidence interval, normal/abnormal classification, or proof of beat-to-beat physiological variation.

fields.value: Irregular ventricular spacing over this short strip, with a conditional mean rate near 80 bpm. Tiny pre-complex excursions are not securely identified as P waves. Sinus arrhythmia remains one possibility, requiring confirmation of uniform sinus P waves before every QRS. The course pattern also requires constant PR 0.12-0.20 s and QRS under 0.12 s; those interval criteria are not established here. No respiratory relationship or alternative atrial mechanism is established.

Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred.

limitations: New wave-field estimates remain provisional and unscored. Range width reflects uncertain endpoints and reader disagreement, not a validated diagnostic category. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established.
The exact original PDF was checked. The inspected waveforms are embedded rasters; larger rendering does not add samples. Expert interpretation may still improve unresolved component identification.
